gloss: thick fried tofu; deep-fried tofu block

definitions.gloss: thick fried tofu; deep-fried tofu block
definitions.explanation: Thick blocks of firm tofu that have been deep-fried until the outside is golden and crispy while the inside remains soft and white. Also called {生揚|なまあ}げ.

examples.japanese: {厚揚|あつあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いて→焼く：01123_yaku⟧しょう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じょうゆ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Grill thick fried tofu and eat it with ginger soy sauce.

examples.japanese: {厚揚|あつあ}げ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make a simmered dish with thick fried tofu and vegetables.
Thick fried tofu can also be used as a meat substitute.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) + {揚|あ}げ (deep-frying)

Literally "thick-fried" - referring to the thick cut of tofu before frying.

ALTERNATIVE NAME:
{生揚|なまあ}げ (nama-age) - same product, different regional name

CONTRAST WITH {油揚|あぶらあ}げ:
- ⟦{油揚|あぶらあ}げ→油揚げ：07477_aburaage⟧ - thin, hollow inside, used for pouches
- {厚揚|あつあ}げ - thick, solid tofu inside, more substantial

TEXTURE:
The outside is crispy and golden brown, while the inside stays soft and white like regular tofu. This dual texture makes it versatile in cooking.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧{厚揚|あつあ}げ - grilled
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ - simmered dishes
- ⟦{炒|いた}め{物|もの}→炒め物：08537_itamemono⟧ - stir-fries
- ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧ - oden hot pot

SERVING SUGGESTIONS:
- しょうがじょうゆ - ginger soy sauce
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧ - grated daikon
- ねぎ - green onions
